Sara (sales): Heads-up — Nimbus Labs renewal is next Tue. They want a 6-week POC extension, to double committed capacity, and they asked for a 25% price adjustment on hosted gen tokens. Need guidance: deal desk approval path + any legal checklist for the POC amendment. @Amy (dealdesk) @Devin (se)
Devin (se): Can we confirm current commit and true utilization? If commit goes 2x we need to validate Dedicated availability or else explain perf/cost tradeoffs. Also any security asks?
Mohit (cs): Current commit = 80M tokens/mo, avg usage ~55M. They say long-term target is ~180M/mo if eval goes well. Security team sent a 3rd-party questionnaire last week — partly filled.
Amy (dealdesk): 25% off on hosted rates is a big exception. Toward approvals: need ARR delta and CSM sign-off on churn risk. What's proposed contract term if they double commit?
Sara (sales): Proposed: 12-month term after POC, with immediate commit ramp to 160M/mo for first 3 months then 180M/mo. Forecast ARR uplift ≈ $720k (ballpark). They want discount applied to token unit price for first 6 months only as an incentive.
Tara (billing): We need clean PO language for the POC extension and the temporary discount period. Need billing contact and whether invoices remain monthly. Also confirm tax jurisdiction (they're EU).
Devin (se): Tech feasibility: if they want low latency at that volume we should offer Dedicated capacity (reserved pool) OR clearly state burst policy on Hosted. If we stay hosted, we may throttle or fallback to smaller model; they'll not like hidden fallbacks. Recommend: offer Dedicated pilot for 6 weeks with a temporary price adjustment (for pilot only).
Sara (sales): Suggested commercial: 6-week POC extension on Dedicated pilot, pilot price = hosted unit price minus 20% (pilot credit) + dedicated ramp commitment to convert to standard commit pricing after pilot. We prefer amortized credit vs flat refund.
Amy (dealdesk): To move forward I need the following: 1) final proposed rate math (unit prices + net ARR), 2) CSM risk note (Mohit), 3) legal approvals checklist (LegalBot). Also specify whether this is a precedent — i.e., will this be offered broadly or one-off.
Mohit (cs): Risk note: high value but moderate churn risk. They are price-sensitive and evaluating alternatives. If we cut price now they'll expect same in renewal unless we gate via term or explicit one-time pilot language. Recommend limiting discount to pilot and tie to conversion triggers.
LegalBot: Uploaded: Nimbus_SecQ_2026_v2 — please review: https://redwood.internal/docs/secq/nimbus_v2 (redacted link)
LegalBot: Checklist for POC amendment: scope of work, data handling addendum (DHA), pilot start/end dates, success criteria, IP carveouts, export controls, and liability cap. Please attach counterparty PO.
Amy (dealdesk): Based on ARR uplift and strategic value, I can approve a pilot credit up to 20% for 6 weeks. Anything >20% needs Director approval. We will require a one-time commercial approval ticket with the rate table and sign-off trail.
Sara (sales): Thanks — I'll prepare the approval packet. Quick rate math (draft):
```
Current hosted list: $0.00200 / token
Requested by customer: 25% off -> $0.00150 / token
Dealdesk pilot approval cap: 20% off -> $0.00160 / token
Proposed pilot commit: 160M tokens/mo for 1 month (6-week pilot spans billing adjustments)
Projected pilot gross = 160,000,000 * $0.00160 = $256,000/mo
Conversion baseline after pilot -> standard tier pricing to be negotiated (no uplift guarantee)
```
Devin (se): Can you add a short note on fallback model behavior if we remain hosted? Also include SLOs for pilot (p50/p95 latency targets) so SRE can scope capacity.
Mohit (cs): I'll draft the CSM risk memo and attach customer communications template. I'll push back if they try to extend pilot discount into renewal.
Tara (billing): Once packet is ready, send to billing@redwood with PO template. For EU customer we need VAT handling and billing contact.
Amy (dealdesk): Once we have the packet I'll open the commercial exception ticket. Please include an explicit line: "one-time pilot credit capped at 20% and non-precedential."
Sara (sales): Great — I'll assemble: commercial packet + filled secQ + CSM memo + PO request. Targeting to file ticket by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :v:
Devin (se): I'll draft SLOs and Dedicated pilot sizing doc and ping eng-sre for capacity checks.
Mohit (cs): I'll coordinate the customer comms and loop Legal for DHA edits.
Amy (dealdesk): FYI — flagging that Director approval lead time is ~48–72h if we need >20%.
Sara (sales): Noted. Will aim for <=20% pilot credit. I'll post the packet here when ready.
